nodes.text: Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) is increasingly recognized in the UK, particularly in children and immunocompromised adults. Symptoms can include respiratory distress, fever, and cough. Pharmacists play a vital role in patient education and management strategies to mitigate risks.
